sql: SELECT CAST(confidence, "float") AS confidence, meta(deviceName) AS deviceName, meta(origin) AS origin FROM FaceStream WHERE meta(profileName) = "face_recog" AND CAST(confidence, "float") > 0.6

rest.dataTemplate: [ { "apiVersion": "v3", "notification": { "category": "FaceAlarm", "severity": "CRITICAL", "content": "Face: {{.confidence}}% exceeds threshold", "sender": "EdgeX_Kuiper", "contentType": "application/json", "description": "A high confidence alert triggered by EdgeX.", "labels": ["FaceRecog", "Confidenceallert"], "status": "NEW" } } ]
